title: Cost reconciliation's verdict inputs for the analysis (F19 plan v5 §2.6.4 and §2.6.5; slices S15 and S11)
description: The minimal record the analysis needs to decide COST_UNRESOLVED by the sealed rule, defined by S11 before S15 (which produces it) exists. Per arm: the counted runs reconciled, how many fell outside their tolerance, and whether the arm's partition reconciled. The analysis applies the sealed reconciliation_mismatch_fraction under layers (c) and (b) and the partition result under (a); it accepts no free-text reason. S15 may add fields; a change to these fields' meaning is a new version.
